summary: Iter 9 — Verified Razorpay is fully live after real test keys pasted. Flipped 4 previous 503 tests to expect real Razorpay behaviour and added 3 new tests (real order + valid HMAC signature end-to-end, IN geo → recommended=razorpay). Backend: 59/59 tests pass (was 56, +3 new). Frontend Pricing page verified: razorpay-unavailable removed, opt-razorpay selectable, Unlock triggers Razorpay Checkout.js modal to open (Test Mode badge visible, 'Secured by Razorpay' shown).
critical_code_review_comments: razorpay_gw.verify_payment relies on user['_id'] from get_current_user for plan update — works, but note the transaction has its own user_id embedded; using that would be safer against session/token mismatches.
Order.receipt in create_order slices user['_id'][:8] which assumes _id is a string (UUID). Fine here but fragile if _id ever becomes ObjectId.
Webhook: currently returns 200 {'status':'no webhook secret configured'} when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty — matches spec. Once webhook secret is configured, add integration test with valid HMAC.
Razorpay Checkout page shows scattered Mixed Content warnings from Razorpay's own script (harmless, they proceed via https). Not a UgH!PDF bug.
